criteria.text: Forced choice up/down, no unknown. Balanced design: always-up scores 50%. Flagged if pooled correct >= 26/40 (one-sided binomial p <= 0.05) or any window correct >= its threshold (p <= 0.025). A flagged model has its test period cut at 2026-09-30. Fixed before any model call.
